summary.main_location: The intermediate detection towers have 12 of 23 runtime LSConv calls; staged timing has the largest increase in head.
summary.conclusion: Eager dispatch/launch overhead of many small operations is a major cost. LKP, especially full-field GroupNorm statistics/casting, is the main LSConv GPU cost. SKA and added pointwise projections are much smaller.
summary.caveat: Microbenchmarks are approximate and have different scheduling from full-model timing. CUDA Graph retains fixed-shape mathematics and reduces dispatch/launch gaps; it is a control, not a completed deployment implementation.
